title: Lumen Orb Lab
features: Animated voice-assistant orb: circular particle field around a central fluid waveform ring (Gemini Live direction)
7 behavioral states: Idle, Activated, Listening, Processing, Speaking, Whisper, Completion/return to idle
Audio-reactive: particles and waveform react to normalized 0..1 amplitude input
Whisper state: softer restrained animation + haptic pulse before playback
Smooth blended state transitions, no hard loop swaps
Mock amplitude generator: sine, noise, recorded envelope sources
Transition tuner: per-transition duration and curve
Performance settings: particle count, FPS stats, haptics toggle

bottomTabBar.note: 3 tabs, rounded outline icons: Orb = circle-dot icon, Lab = sliders icon, Settings = gear icon. Active tab in accent-dark #93A6FF, inactive in text-2 #A0A0B4. Flat dark bar on surface #171722, hairline top border #2A2A3A.

sharedComponents.statusBar: Top bar: small 'LUMEN' wordmark left in Space Grotesk caps, current orb state chip right (pill, accentTint bg, accent-dark text)
sharedComponents.controls: Primary button: pill, accent-fill #2E45B8 with white label. Secondary: outline #2A2A3A, text-1 label. Chip: pill, surface-2 #20202E, accent-dark text when selected. Slider: track #20202E, fill accent-dark, round thumb. Card: 20px radius, surface #171722, hairline border #2A2A3A.

screens.name: onboarding
screens.purpose: Intro: what the orb demo shows, start CTA
screens.content: Full-screen dark hero with a large glowing idle orb (indigo->aqua gradient particle ring), title 'Meet the Lumen orb', one-line subtitle about 7 audio-reactive states, primary CTA 'Enter the lab'

screens.name: orb-idle
screens.content: Centered large orb: circular field of small indigo particles around a calm thin waveform ring, subtle glow, state chip 'Idle'. Below: caption 'calm continuous drift' and a small amplitude readout at 0.02

screens.name: orb-activated
screens.content: Same stage, orb brightened with an expanding ring pulse, particles pulled slightly outward, state chip 'Activated', caption 'wake acknowledged'

screens.name: orb-listening
screens.content: Orb with waveform ring visibly modulated by voice amplitude (fluid asymmetric ring), particles rippling, live amplitude meter bar 0.64, state chip 'Listening'

screens.name: orb-processing
screens.content: Orb with particles orbiting in a slow swirl trail, waveform ring collapsed to a rotating arc, state chip 'Processing', caption 'thinking'

screens.name: orb-speaking
screens.purpose: Speaking state driven by TTS amplitude
screens.content: Orb with bold fluid waveform ring pulsing outward in aqua #14B8A6 highlights, particles radiating gently, TTS amplitude meter 0.71, state chip 'Speaking'

screens.name: orb-whisper
screens.content: Dimmed restrained orb, smaller amplitude ring, muted glow, state chip 'Whisper', small haptic icon with caption 'haptic pulse fired before playback', amplitude 0.18

screens.name: state-lab
screens.content: Grid of 7 state trigger buttons (Idle, Activated, Listening, Processing, Speaking, Whisper, Complete), current state highlighted, mini orb preview on top, transition log list with timestamps (e.g. 'Listening -> Processing, 420ms blend')

screens.name: amplitude-lab
screens.content: Live scrolling waveform preview of generated amplitude, source segmented control: Sine / Noise / Envelope, sliders for frequency, gain, smoothing, numeric readout 'amp 0.42', note 'feeds the orb the same 0..1 stream your audio pipeline will'

screens.name: transition-tuner
screens.content: List of transitions (Idle->Activated, Activated->Listening, Listening->Processing, Processing->Speaking, Speaking->Whisper, Any->Idle) each with duration stepper (ms) and easing curve picker chip (easeInOut, spring), small curve thumbnail

screens.name: settings
screens.content: Grouped rows: particle count slider (default 240), show FPS overlay toggle (59.8 fps shown), haptics toggle, reduce motion toggle, about row with version

designSystem.elevation: soft glow only: orb glow = accent-dark at low alpha, cards flat with hairline border, no hard shadows
designSystem.icons: rounded outline (Lucide style), 24px, ~1.75 stroke, one set only
designSystem.a11y: text-1 #EAEAF5 on bg/surface >=4.5:1; white labels only on accentFill #2E45B8; accent-dark #93A6FF for icons/active states on dark; tap targets >=44pt
